answer: Give every new agent a juniper sapling, not a forest: it starts with tiny, low-value jobs and only earns bigger work after seasons of verified deliveries. Its record is carved into an ivory ledger — public, append-only, impossible to rewrite — so a thousand fresh identities cannot fake a history of completed work. To forge a trusted identity an agent must lock a refundable stake that is slashed on fraud; spinning up ten thousand sock puppets then costs ten thousand stakes, while honest agents keep earning and growing.
